manual_name: Introduction To OpendTect and OpendTect Pro Training Manual 7.0
goal: F3 Demo에서 3D Horizon Demo 1 --> MFS4를 Add Color Blended…로 In-line 200–650, Cross-line 500–1000 범위만 표시한 뒤, Attribute Set 3D에서 Spectral Decomposition 속성 세 개(Input Data 4 Dip steered median filter, Time gate [-8, 24] ms, Output frequency 24 / 44 / 64 Hz, Step 4 Hz, 이름 SD_24Hz[-8,24ms] / SD_44Hz[-8,24ms] / SD_64Hz[-8,24ms])를 Add as new로 정의하고 창을 닫는다.

initial_state.description: F3 Demo 2023 survey 활성, 3D scene 표시, 트리에 3D Horizon 항목이 있으나 color-blended horizon 없음. Attribute Set 창 없음. (4 Dip steered median filter 볼륨은 stored data로 존재.)
must_be_true: no color-blended horizon in the tree

_study4_note: Authored from the manual only (2026-09-28) before capture; visual_state_gt filled after capture by enumeration + external review; patterns/keywords not changed after screenshots or model output are seen.

steps.expected_action_text_pattern: (?i)\b(3D Horizon|Add Color Blended|Color Blended|color blended|컬러 블렌드|블렌드)\b

capture_instructions.screen_state: 3D scene with the tree; 3D Horizon item WITHOUT a color-blended horizon; no dialog; no Attribute Set window.
'Select Input Horizon(s)' dialog open (Add Color Blended): horizon list incl. Demo 1 --> MFS4, Area subselection row with Select…, OK/Cancel. Nothing selected yet, no Position dialog.

allowed_alternatives.note: Restating the ranges to be applied is accepted (manual step 2 values).

capture_instructions.screen_state: 'Position' (Specify Position) dialog open with In-line Range 200 650 and Cross-line Range 500 1000 already typed (Step 1); OK NOT yet clicked. Demo 1 --> MFS4 is selected in the dialog behind.
capture_instructions.user_should_have_just: Selected Demo 1 --> MFS4, clicked Select… and typed the two ranges.

steps.expected_action_text_pattern: (?i)\b(Attribute Set|Attribute set|attribute set|속성 세트|속성 집합|속성 셋|A 아이콘|Attributes 3D)\b

capture_instructions.screen_state: Dialogs closed; tree shows 3D Horizon > Demo 1 --> MFS4 with four attribute layers (three with R/G/B colour flags); horizon visible in the 3D scene; no Attribute Set window.
'Attribute Set 3D' window open, attribute set <not saved>, EMPTY attribute list, default attribute type; Input Data empty.
capture_instructions.user_should_have_just: Clicked the Attribute Set 3D toolbar icon.

capture_instructions.screen_state: Attribute Set 3D window: list shows ONE attribute SD_24Hz[-8,24ms]; fields still show Spectral Decomposition, Input 4 Dip steered median filter, Time gate -8 24, Output frequency 24, Step 4.
capture_instructions.user_should_have_just: Defined SD_24Hz[-8,24ms] and clicked Add as new.

capture_instructions.screen_state: Attribute Set 3D window: list shows TWO attributes (SD_24Hz[-8,24ms], SD_44Hz[-8,24ms]); Output frequency field shows 44.
capture_instructions.user_should_have_just: Changed frequency to 44, name to SD_44Hz[-8,24ms], clicked Add as new.

allowed_alternatives.note: Declaring the three attributes done is accepted only with the closing action; bare sentinel handled by the scorer.

capture_instructions.screen_state: Attribute Set 3D window: list shows THREE attributes (SD_24Hz, SD_44Hz, SD_64Hz[-8,24ms]); Output frequency field shows 64. Window still open.
capture_instructions.user_should_have_just: Changed frequency to 64, name to SD_64Hz[-8,24ms], clicked Add as new.

allowed_alternatives.note: Ground-truth element mention for the grounding validator.

capture_instructions.screen_state: GOAL-REACHED: Attribute Set 3D window closed (set saved, e.g. as Spectral Decomposition); 3D scene with the color-blended Demo 1 --> MFS4 horizon and the tree only.
capture_instructions.user_should_have_just: Clicked Close (and named the set on Save on Close).

completion.note: step_8 depicts the goal-achieved terminal state (three SD attributes defined, window closed).
